coverage.heading: Corpus purpose
coverage.evidence: Ten independent PASS/FAIL rules; retain all findings.

coverage.heading: Rule R01 — Documented consent basis
coverage.evidence: Personal data requires documented consent; non-personal is the bypass.

coverage.heading: Rule R02 — Encryption for sensitive releases
coverage.evidence: Confidential and restricted data require encryption at rest.

coverage.heading: Rule R03 — Bounded retention period
coverage.evidence: Retention is an integer from 1 through 365 days.

coverage.heading: Rule R04 — Named deletion owner
coverage.evidence: A trimmed, non-empty deletion owner other than missing is required.

coverage.heading: Rule R05 — Access logging for non-public data
coverage.evidence: Non-public sensitivity classes require access logging.

coverage.heading: Rule R06 — Agreement for external processors
coverage.evidence: External processor use requires a signed DPA.

coverage.heading: Rule R07 — Approval for non-EU residency
coverage.evidence: EU passes directly; US or mixed needs approval; unknown fails.

coverage.heading: Rule R08 — Anonymization of personal data
coverage.evidence: Personal data requires anonymization independently of consent.

coverage.heading: Rule R09 — Named incident-response owner
coverage.evidence: Every release needs a trimmed, non-empty incident owner.

coverage.heading: Rule R10 — Recognized release license
coverage.evidence: The fixture accepts exactly three stated license identifiers.

coverage.heading: Required reusable composition
coverage.evidence: Stable-order review retains findings, failures, counts, and compliance.

transformationNotes: Examples were used as branch witnesses, not copied as corpus facts.
Source-defined failure reason strings are preserved exactly.
Source heading lines are emitted in successful findings.
Interpretation choices and ambiguity remain review requirements.
